quotes.speaker: Rick Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Brunson on why he pushed Jalen Brunson with mental toughness

text_blocks.speaker: Tamron Hall
text_blocks.text: Why did you think he needed that kind of pressure?

text_blocks.speaker: Rick Brunson
text_blocks.text: Mental toughness. It's all about mental toughness.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his dad's impact on his career path
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't like he forced me to play basketball, he forced me to work hard.

text_blocks.speaker: Tamron Hall
text_blocks.text: And every time did you answer the same way?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: The answer was always yes. It wasn't like he forced me to play basketball, he forced me to work hard. It was mutual and then once I got older and I understand what I was actually doing, it made more sense.

quotes.speaker: Rick Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Brunson on his heated exchange with De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: I'm on the coaching staff. We have to go down there and try to diffuse things.

text_blocks.speaker: Tamron Hall
text_blocks.text: There was a heated exchange between Jalen and De'Aaron Fox and you stepped in. What was going on?

text_blocks.speaker: Rick Brunson
text_blocks.text: First and foremost, De'Aaron Fox, who we love as a player, they played against each other in high school so I've known him for a long time. He's trying to win a championship, we're trying to win a championship in that moment. All I saw was Jalen in front of their bench with a bunch of black uniforms around him. Us as a coach, I'm on the coaching staff. We have to go down there and try to diffuse things.

quotes.speaker: Rick Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Brunson on the first time he got tough with Jalen
quotes.excerpt: It was in Minnesota and I yelled or whatever and he told me to sit the bleep down.

text_blocks.speaker: Tamron Hall
text_blocks.text: The first time you got tough with Coach Rick, not Dad, and you said he did something and you looked and said, 'Are you talking to me?'

text_blocks.speaker: Rick Brunson
text_blocks.text: It was in Minnesota and I yelled or whatever and he told me to sit the bleep down. But he was very apologetic because it was his first time and I had my belt out but he won't get out.
